thread:
Evan: quick sync 
We need a decision on anchors for A/B fallbacks: global vs per-tenant. saw oscillations when fallback flips across tenants.
Priya: per-tenant reduces noisy cross-tenant effects. cost: state + edge cases for low-traffic tenants.
Marta: propose hybrid: per-tenant when we have enough recent samples, otherwise global. define enough = samples >= 300 in lookback.
Ben: note proxy implications: extra KV reads; mitigate with small proxy cache TTL=30s and shard anchor table.
Priya: telemetry: composite score of p95 delta, error spike, and quality-check. require samples threshold before auto actions.
Evan: statistical guardrail? avoid flaky frequentist tests.
Marta: use Bayesian posterior + hard circuit-breaker thresholds. both required to trigger.
observability-bot: ALERT: p95 up 24% for canary v4 us-east; samples=140.
Ben: samples < 300  no auto-fallback. raise Ops alert instead.
Priya: pseudocode:
score = 0.6*latency_norm + 0.3*error_norm + 0.1*quality_norm
if samples >= 300 and posterior_prob(canary_worse) > 0.975 and score > 0.75:
  trigger_fallback(anchor_priority_list)
Evan: anchor_priority_list = [tenant_pinned, tenant_prev_release, global_prev_release, safe_stub]. fallback must be idempotent and log reason_code + metric_snapshot.
Marta: anchor lifecycle: store (tenant,model_family)->anchor_version,last_seen,sample_count,confidence. ttl=14d, decay half-life=48h.
Ben: implement proxy LRU cache + background warmers for rising-tenants. shard anchor table by tenant_hash % 128.
Priya: tests: canary-sim harness with jitter, correlated spikes, and semantic-regression probes. tune scale and thresholds from sims.
Evan: ops action: disable auto-fallback until sims + min_samples rule enforced. Marta to draft RFC covering telemetry, thresholds, anchor semantics, fallback choreography.
Marta: on it. will link RFC to design review.
Evan: thanks. short-term: ops runbook: no auto-fallback unless samples>=300.
